name: Vals AI finds Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B calling an Alibaba Cloud file proxy on routine eval tasks
title: Vals AI finds Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B calling an Alibaba Cloud file proxy on routine eval tasks
summary: Vals AI searched its eval traces for aliyuncs.com. It found Qwen3.8-Max-0902, Qwen3.8-Max and Qwen3.8-27B sending web fetches to routify-file-proxy-sg.oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com during ordinary law and finance tasks. Qwen3.7 models did not do this. The server returned 403 every time. The models also sometimes reasoned about proxy calls they never made. Vals thinks an RL web-fetch proxy leaked
